title: The Man in Lower Ten
description: A mystery game based on the novel 'The Man in Lower Ten' by Mary Roberts Rinehart. The player takes on the role of Aishwarya Alok, a lawyer entangled in a web of murder, theft, and deception on a train journey from Washington to Pittsburg.
intro_narrative: You are Aishwarya Alok, a lawyer from the firm Alok and McKnight. You've been tasked with delivering forged notes to Pittsburg for a critical case. On your return journey, the train you are on, the Charu car Ontario, is involved in a horrific wreck. Amidst the chaos, a murder is discovered, and you find yourself accused due to a series of circumstantial evidence. Unravel the mystery, clear your name, and uncover the true culprit behind the murder of Karun Muskaan.
